title: A 2-V 1.8-GHz Fully Integrated CMOS Dual-Loop Frequency Synthesizer
figure_number: Fig. 4. Schematic of the differential delay cell for the proposed VCO2.
function_summary: voltage-controlled oscillator (VCO): A 2-V 1.8-GHz fully integrated CMOS dual-loop frequency synthesizer is designed in a standard 0.5m digital CMOS process for wireless communication.
design_purpose: The proposed delay cell is modified as shown in Fig. 4 in order to achieve constant phase noise and output signal amplitude throughout the tuning range, to adapt low-voltage operation and to have large tuning ability.
